#### Description
The Dynamic Port Breakout feature is not working as expected on the latest master image

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. `sudo config interface breakout Ethernet0 4x100G[50G] -f`

**NOTE:**

1) Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/9075
2) Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/9276
#### Describe the results you received:
```
admin@sonic:~$ sudo config interface breakout Ethernet192 4x100G[50G] -f

Failed to break out Port. Error: Failed to load the config. Error: ConfigMgmtDPB Class creation failed
```
#### Describe the results you expected:
config interface breakout should work without errors

#### Output of `show version`:
For testing, I manually built the sonic-image 15 November 2021 with last commits on the sonic-buildimage master and resolved issues which I mentioned in "NOTE" to "Steps to reproduce the issue".

@mykolaxgerasymenko Facing this issue on Mellanox SN2700 after resolving the issues mentioned in the NOTE. I observed that in sonic-feature. yang under /src/sonic-yang-models/yang-models, leaf "has_global_scope" has a type **boolean** and the default is **false**, yet it is considered as an Invalid value.

Have you tried adding boolean as typedef under sonic-types.yang.j2 ? I believe that shouldn't be necessary, but let me know if you have tried it.

linkedPullRequests.title: [DPB][YANG] Fix cases when boolean is used in different literal cases
linkedPullRequests.author: mykolaxgerasymenko
linkedPullRequests.body:
* Add boolean as typedef to sonic-types
* Fix boolean in sonic-feature yang model
* Fix boolean in sonic-flex_counter yang model

Signed-off-by: Mykola Gerasymenko <mykolax.gerasymenko@intel.com>

Fixes #9326
<!--
     Please make sure you've read and understood our contributing guidelines:
     https://github.com/Azure/SONiC/blob/gh-pages/CONTRIBUTING.md

     ** Make sure all your commits include a signature generated with `git commit -s` **

     If this is a bug fix, make sure your description includes "fixes #xxxx", or
     "closes #xxxx" or "resolves #xxxx"

     Please provide the following information:
-->

#### Why I did it
When we try execute DPB from CLI we have error:
`libyang[0]: Invalid value "False" in "has_global_scope" element. (path: /sonic-feature:sonic-feature/FEATURE/FEATURE_LIST[name='bgp']/has_global_scope)`
The reason for this issue is that has_global_scope and other have been stored in redis database with value False or True form capital letter:
```
   "FEATURE":{
      "bgp":{
         "auto_restart":"enabled",
         "has_global_scope":"False",
         "has_per_asic_scope":"True",
         "has_timer":"False",
         "high_mem_alert":"disabled",
         "state":"enabled"
      }
```
But yang model support boolean just in lowercase letters (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6020#section-9.5.1).
#### How I did it
Added boolean to sonic-types as typedef with different literal cases.

#### How to verify it
Run the command config interface breakout <breakout_mode>

**NOTE:**
To verify this fix, the following PRs that fix other problems in SONiC must be merged into master:
1) Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/9075
2) Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/9276
